FALCONER-ERRAND.title: Errand
FALCONER-ERRAND.description:
[gold]Send[/gold] the falcon away. It returns at the start of a later turn and the Errand resolves:
Hunt (1 turn): 10 damage to a random enemy.
Stoop (2): 24 damage to the enemy with the most HP.
Scout (1): draw 2, gain 4 Block.
Fetch (1): a card from your discard pile to your hand; it costs 0 this turn.
Harry (2): 1 Weak each turn; 5 damage on return.
Forage (3): gain 1 energy, heal 3.
Sending while Away resolves the old Errand at 50% first. Errands get 10% stronger per Falcon Level.
FALCONER-PERCHED.title: Perched
FALCONER-PERCHED.description: The falcon is on your glove (not on an Errand).
FALCONER-ALONE.title: Alone
FALCONER-ALONE.description: The falcon is Away on an Errand.
FALCONER-RECALL.title: Recall
FALCONER-RECALL.description: The falcon returns now; its Errand resolves at 50%.
